observations: This graph is regex-based, not a real C parser: it resolves direct calls to the first same-named function definition found anywhere in first-party sources, so it can mis-attribute calls when two files define functions with the same name.

Function-pointer/vtable dispatch (driver operation tables, open62541 callback registration, FreeRTOS task entry points passed by address) is invisible to this extraction and is documented separately in docs/code/call-graphs.md and docs/code/freertos.md with manual path:line citations.

15 modules show zero inbound static call/include edges; most of these are reached only through function pointers or task creation and are NOT actually dead — treat this list as candidates requiring manual confirmation, not conclusions.
libraries/, open62541_v1.5.3/, and port/ are excluded as vendor/third-party and are not represented as graph nodes.
